written.myAnswer: Single precision uses an 8-bit exponent with bias 127, giving an actual exponent range of −126 to +127. Its approximate positive value range is 1.4 × 10⁻⁴⁵ to 3.4 × 10³⁸.
Floating-point representation can introduce rounding errors. Understanding its limitations helps scientists monitor those errors and maintain accuracy in calculations.
